title: The Rupert Problem for convex polyhedra
abstract: Formalizes the Rupert property for the cube, the regular tetrahedron, and the triakis tetrahedron, exhibiting for each an explicit straight-through hole admitting a congruent copy.

informal.Cube.rupert: Proves that the cube has the Rupert property.
informal.Tetrahedron.rupert: Proves that the regular tetrahedron has the Rupert property.
informal.TriakisTetrahedron.rupert: Proves that the triakis tetrahedron has the Rupert property.
